traits.name: Fast Shot
traits.description: You don't have time to aim. Ranged attacks cost 1 less AP, but you can't take aimed (called) shots.

traits.name: Finesse
traits.description: Precision over power. +10% critical chance, but -1 to all damage.

traits.name: Small Frame
traits.description: Light and nimble. +1 Reflex, but you carry 15 less.

traits.name: Heavy Handed
traits.description: You swing with everything you have. +4 melee damage, but -10% critical chance.

traits.name: Gifted
traits.description: Naturally talented. +1 Grit, Reflex, Mind, Body, Nerve and Presence, but -15 to all skills.
